page: The friction ledger of 金_比肩 (Metal carrying The Twin) on a Metal core: three rows, three angles each
facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 金_比肩 (Metal carrying The Twin). Persona The Twin (比肩). Definition line: "Same nature, same register, the standard you hold yourself to". Keyword Independence, charge steady, poles catalyst Self-trust / friction Isolation. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: the standard held to oneself; company that truly matches is rare. Arena: mirrors, stride, equal measure, walking beside. Classical portrait: same nature, same register; the standard held to oneself; self-reliance that can wall others out. Ruled domains: Peers, Independence, Self-reliance. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 劫财.
Element arena: Metal (edge, blade, ore, forge, whetstone, the clean line). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal precision amplifying Metal — same-polarity self-referencing loop".
- k2_overview: "Your Metal moves as the Twin: a standing force that meets the world edge-first and equal. Nothing about you waits for permission. You hold your line the way a blade holds its shape, and you respect exactly the people who hold theirs. Company, for you, is two swords in one sheath: close, parallel, never fused."
- k2_functional: "Your energy is tempered and even: slow to tire, slow to bend, restored by solitary work."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Self-made","Reserved","Unshakeable"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Peers":"Your peers are fellow blades: rivals you respect, colleagues you measure against, friends won through tested mettle. Keep two or three whose standards match yours. Iron sharpens iron is not a proverb to you. It is your social life.","Independence":"Independence, in metal, is structural: you do not perform autonomy, you are made of it. Guard it without sealing it. A blade alone stays sharp but unused, and your edge exists for work that matters.","Self-reliance":"You carry your own weight and everyone can feel it. The practice to add is borrowing well: one tool, one favor, one opinion at a time. Even the finest steel was forged by other hands."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 金_劫财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Keen-edged","Competitive","Unfazed"],"friction":["Cutthroat","Abrasive","Picks fights"]}
- Sibling cell 金_劫财 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Winning has stopped checking its methods with you. The shortcut through a colleague’s territory, the information used a half-step past fair, the alliance dropped at the moment of maximum value: each move defensible in isolation, and together a style that people describe with one hand on their wallet."

Core element Metal, energy element Metal. Law: Metal and Metal are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Metal is this core's Body. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Metal on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Metal as the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 金_金's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You stay sealed off long after the reason has gone. There is Metal to spare in you, so you seal yourself off from help without noticing whether you want any. Remember that you meant to seal out the hurt rather than your peers.

value_b.text: The sealed version of you is the only one on offer. Since your Metal is more than you need, sealing off costs nothing and being unreachable comes ahead of being known. Part of you still wants to be known rather than kept safe.

value.text: A hurt is the first thing you seal off, before anyone notices. Needing no one proves you are fine, and you keep it sealed instead of letting help in. You carry each hurt alone, and you lose the evenings you wanted to share.

value.text: Being taught lands on you as an attack first and information second. With Metal running over, you put your own judgment ahead of any peer's lesson. You are taught only by people you let be right, and you rarely let them.

value_b.text: A correction feels like being made smaller, so you argue instead of being taught. With more Metal than you spend, holding your ground beats letting anyone teach you. You already know you get to be right or get taught, and choose each time.

value.text: Asking once costs you more than doing a thing twice yourself. Metal is heavy in you, so asking reads as failure and carrying alone reads as proof. You count the asking as a cost and leave the carrying off the bill.

value_b.text: Help is the one thing you never learned to ask for. With Metal to spare, carrying alone looks possible, so getting it done comes ahead of asking. You settle every favour you never ask, in your own time and on your own back.

value.text: Where a job is heavy, you take it all instead of asking for half. To prove you are enough, you carry it alone and spend sleep before spending one question. You pay in lost sleep for help you never ask for.

value.text: Being nobody's burden is why you ask no one. Since you would rather owe nothing than be joined, you take the job back the moment someone offers. You send away the peer who offered and leave them no way to help you.
